mapper.select: SELECT * FROM inspection_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND next_inspection_date IS NOT NULL AND next_inspection_date <= #{warningDate} AND status != 'completed' ORDER BY next_inspection_date ASC

SELECT * FROM inspection_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND next_inspection_date IS NOT NULL AND next_inspection_date < #{currentDate} AND status != 'completed' ORDER BY next_inspection_date ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN next_inspection_date < CURDATE() AND status != 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as overdueCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as completionRate, SUM(CASE WHEN next_inspection_date < CURDATE() AND status != 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as overdueRate FROM inspection_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND inspection_date >= #{startDate} AND inspection_date <= #{endDate}

SELECT inspection_type as inspectionType, COUNT(*) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failCount FROM inspection_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY inspection_type ORDER BY totalCount DESC

SELECT ac.category_name as categoryName, COUNT(ir.id) as totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.result = 'PASS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as passCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ir.result = 'FAIL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failCount FROM inspection_record ir INNER JOIN asset a ON ir.asset_id = a.id INNER JOIN asset_category ac ON a.category_id = ac.id WHERE ir.deleted = 0 AND ir.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND a.deleted = 0 GROUP BY ac.id, ac.category_name ORDER BY totalCount DESC
